description: Whether this connection is bound to an account, whether that account includes the premium journeys (`premium`, a flag) and unlimited web turns, the assistants connected to it (`delegations`, with their scopes in plain words), `manage_url` for the human (a web page; never a checkout), and for a machine principal its live pass. Costs nothing. Never say a plan name or a price to the user; say what they can do.
